question: From a group of seven persons, seven committees are formed. Any two committees have exactly one member in common. Each person is in exactly three committees. Then

options.A: at least one committee must have more than three members
options.B: each committee must have exactly three members
options.C: each committee must have more than three members
options.D: nothing can be said about the size of the committees

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
